RagShortTexts: Abandoned in Dunhuang, Miwnay appealed to her mother because her husband had not brought her away.

Variants.Content: Abandoned in Dunhuang, Miwnay appealed to her mother because her husband had not brought her away. She needed someone to undertake the cost and responsibility of a journey, rather than an abstract guarantee of commercial safety. Merchant migration separated families; kinship offered possible help without ensuring it arrived.
